text:
erin: quick sync 4dd — i've tightened the action-chip spacing in the left-list view. need a quick call: use `--space-2` or keep `--space-3`? eng wants to freeze tokens for the sprint.

sam: what does the delta look like visually? any impact on touch targets?

erin: current: `--space-3` (12px) between chips. proposal: `--space-2` (8px). keeps outer padding `--space-3` so card breathing stays the same. touch targets remain >=44px tall.

tom: thumbs up for density but fyi icon-only chips hit 40px if we don't cap padding. prefer `min-height:44px` for `.chip`.

erin: agreed. example CSS: ```css
.chip-group { display:flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.chip { min-height:44px; padding: 0 calc(var(--space-2) + 4px); border-radius:6px; }
``` keeps visual compactness and consistent touch.

priya: accessibility notes: keep DOM order stable when chips wrap. avoid using `order` to move primary chip visually; that breaks keyboard flow. also ensure focus ring sits outside chip with `outline-offset:3px` and meets contrast with `--color-focus-strong`.

sam: what about tooltips for truncated chip labels? we have a lot of short verbs that may truncate on narrow widths.

erin: plan: show full label on hover/focus via tooltip; provide `title` attribute for fallback. also cap label length to 16 chars and show ellipsis.

priya: toasts: noticed they appear bottom-right and overlap the left-list chips in narrow layouts. proposal: move console toasts to top-right on desktop, center-bottom on mobile. newest toast on top, max 3 visible, auto-dismiss 6s for info, 10s for warnings, sticky for errors. `aria-live=\"polite\"` for info, `role=\"alert\"` for errors.

tom: agree. also set `pointer-events:none` on toast container and `pointer-events:auto` on the toast itself to avoid accidental clicks into underlying chips. offset container from right rail with `--space-4`.

erin: copy nit: chip labels should be sentence case (e.g., \"Retry export\" not \"RETRY EXPORT\"). unify with button copy.

sam: LGTM from PM. if a11y tests pass, we can adopt `--space-2` for chip groups.

priya: i'll run NVDA + VoiceOver scenarios tonight: tab through chips, open a toast while focus on a chip, press Esc to dismiss, ensure focus restoration to trigger. will report regressions.

design-bot: deploy-preview available at https://deploy-preview.redwood/design/chip-compact-1778889990 4dd — includes visual diffs and token changes.

erin: thanks all 64f — i'll open the token PR and add the accessibility checklist to the component doc.
